name: Nurse practitioners
oneLiner: The fastest-growing occupation in the BLS table, at 41% — more than ten times the economy-wide rate.
why: Prescribing and diagnosing means legal accountability, which cannot be delegated to a model
Care teams are being restructured around these roles, not away from them
The clinical relationship carries the outcome; a wrong call is a harmed patient
threats: Documentation and routine triage shrink the administrative half of the role
Training pipelines still depend on supervised hours that AI is not replacing

claims.text: The fastest-growing occupation in BLS projections to 2035, at 41%, against 3.5% for all occupations.
Providers are relying more on these roles to deliver care under collaborative, team-based models.
